cod.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo (state)
cod.description: Congolese state. Use a sub-entity whenever the force actually holding the place is known.

cod-fardc.name: Forces Armées de la République Démocratique du Congo
cod-fardc.description: Army. Controller where the army is the main permanent force (garrison towns, operation zones, mining sites it runs).

cod-pnc.name: Police Nationale Congolaise
cod-pnc.description: National police. Default controller of state-held towns and neighbourhoods where order is kept by police posts/commissariats.

cod-gr.name: Garde Républicaine
cod-gr.description: Presidential guard; controller only where it is the main permanent force (e.g. presidential areas of Kinshasa).

cod-wazalendo.name: Wazalendo / Volontaires pour la Défense de la Patrie (VDP)
cod-wazalendo.description: Umbrella of pro-government armed groups (mostly ex Mai-Mai/Nyatura) legalised as reservists in 2023. Use it only when the specific group is unknown; individual groups that act autonomously are separate top-level entities.

afc-m23.name: Alliance Fleuve Congo / Mouvement du 23 Mars
afc-m23.description: Rebel movement administering parts of Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu (Goma, Bukavu since early 2025) with its own administration, police and army.

bdi-fdnb.name: Force de Défense Nationale du Burundi

adf.name: Allied Democratic Forces / ISCAP
adf.description: Islamic State Central Africa Province affiliate active in Beni, Lubero (Nord-Kivu) and Irumu, Mambasa (Ituri).

codeco.name: Coopérative pour le Développement du Congo (CODECO) factions

zaire.name: Convention pour la Révolution Populaire / Zaïre
zaire.description: Hema-based self-defence militia in Djugu (Ituri); CRP led by Thomas Lubanga (allied to AFC/M23).

fpic.name: Front Patriotique et Intégrationniste du Congo

frpi.name: Force de Résistance Patriotique de l'Ituri

fdlr.name: Forces Démocratiques de Libération du Rwanda

apcls.name: Alliance des Patriotes pour un Congo Libre et Souverain

mm-mazembe.name: Mai-Mai Mazembe / UPLC and related Lubero militias

cnpsc.name: Coalition Nationale du Peuple pour la Souveraineté du Congo (Mai-Mai Yakutumba)

twirwaneho.name: Twirwaneho
twirwaneho.description: Banyamulenge self-defence group, Hauts Plateaux of Sud-Kivu; allied with AFC/M23 since 2025.

mobondo.name: Mobondo militia
mobondo.description: Yaka/Suku-based militia active in Kwamouth (Maï-Ndombe), Kwango, Kwilu and Kinshasa outskirts since 2022.

customary.name: Customary authority (chief's guards) without state force

cod-iccn.name: Institut Congolais pour la Conservation de la Nature (ICCN) eco-guards
cod-iccn.description: Armed park rangers of the state conservation agency; controller only at park headquarters/stations and inside protected areas.

mm-simba.name: Mai-Mai Simba (Mambasa/Bafwasende)
mm-simba.description: Fragmented Mai-Mai Simba groups (successors of Paul Sadala 'Morgan' and 'Manu'/Lumumba factions) engaged in poaching, illegal gold mining and raids in and around the Okapi Wildlife Reserve and Maiko park (Mambasa, Bafwasende).

lra.name: Lord's Resistance Army (LRA)
lra.description: Lord's Resistance Army - Ugandan-origin rebel group whose remnants raid and abduct in Bas-Uele/Haut-Uele from bases in CAR.

car-seleka.name: Ex-Seleka CAR armed factions
car-seleka.description: Ex-Seleka Central African armed factions (e.g. UPC elements) making cross-border incursions into Bas-Uele.

mbororo-armed.name: Armed Mbororo herders
mbororo-armed.description: Armed transhumant Mbororo (Fulani) cattle herders in the Uele provinces, accused of killings, kidnappings and crop destruction; no fixed territorial control.

ssd-spla-io.name: SPLA-IO (Sudan People's Liberation Army in Opposition)
ssd-spla-io.description: South Sudanese armed opposition (Riek Machar's SPLM-IO); elements from Central Equatoria cross into Aru/Faradje (DRC) for looting and abductions; called 'AIO' locally.

ssd-sspdf.name: South Sudan People's Defence Forces
ssd-sspdf.description: National army of South Sudan; soldiers reported making cross-border incursions into Aru territory (Ituri) in 2025-2026.

mdkc.name: Mouvement Débout Katanga pour la Libération du Congo (MDKC)
mdkc.description: Katangese separatist armed movement that surfaced in March 2026 claiming the capture of Lusinga (Upemba NP, Mitwaba); overlaps with Bakata Katanga Mai-Mai networks; no confirmed durable territorial control.

cod-service-national.name: Service National (RDC)
cod-service-national.description: Paramilitary national service under the presidency that runs civic/re-education training centres and agricultural domains (notably Kaniama-Kasese); controller only at its own sites.

drc-swarm-1.notes: One research agent per territory/city unit; see scripts/drc/agent_prompt.md
